rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the lifespan of a person, animal, object, or project.

example.english: This phone has a lifetime of about five years.
example.traditional: 呢部手機嘅壽命大概有五年。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 sau6 ming6 daai6 koi3 jau5 ng5 nin4

rows.note: Use this for a person's whole lifetime or emphatically for a very long time, as in waiting ages.

example.english: I've never eaten anything this spicy in my lifetime.
example.traditional: 我成世都未試過食咁辣嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 sai3 dou1 mei6 si3 gwo3 sik6 gam3 laat6 ge3 je5
